title: The Blues Hotel
author: The Blues Hotel Collective
description: Welcome to The Blues Hotel A guided journey through the past, present, and future of the blues. Each episode honours the legends, spotlights Victorian talent in Live at the MBAS, uncovers the true stories behind classics in Backstory Blues, pairs originals with modern takes in Then & Now, and welcomes emerging Australian artists into The Blues Hotel Collective Family.
